intro: "The Adventurer" is an introductory journey quest on Zephras Isle. Given by Aetheen of the Gales in Thendal Grove, it directs newly seasoned wanderers southwest toward Shen'dar Village to meet Raan Wildwind, a veteran camper who knows the wilds.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: More and more adventurers like yourself have been seeking glory and fortune outside of the safety of Thendal Grove. There's one such adventurer who has made a camp outside of Shen'dar Village, along the road leading southwest out of Thendal Grove.
Seek him out and see what you can learn from him that may help you in your own travels.
